Composition & Indication

Omega-3 Fish Oil 1000mg — 60 Softgels contains Omega-3 Fatty Acids (EPA/DHA) 1000 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 60 Softgels at the official 1000mg strength. The standard indication is the management of cardiovascular and joint support, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Omega-3 Fish Oil 1000mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

For adult use as directed. Consult your healthcare provider if symptoms persist. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
